label: Shader Routing Organ
purpose: Routes premium text effects toward engine-native shader/material implementations so glow, sheen, metal, and glitch remain modular and reusable.
rules: Small body text should keep simple native rendering and avoid heavy shader stacks.
Hero text may use engine-native material passes for glow, bevel, sheen, and glitch.
Reduced motion must disable animated sweeps or jitter in every engine.
